# All Research Journal

> A peer-reviewed, multidisciplinary open-access research journal publishing original research across diverse scientific fields with rigorous editorial standards and international indexing.

All Research Journal (IJAR) is an international academic publishing platform based in Delhi, India, offering manuscript submission, peer review, publication services, and book publishing through AkiNik Publications. The journal maintains indexing across major databases including Google Scholar, Crossref, and Scopus, with transparent metrics and ethical publication standards.

- [Manuscript Submission](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/submission): Submit research papers to International Journal of Applied Research

- [Peer Review and Publication Policy](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/publication-policy): Peer review process and publication guidelines with plagiarism detection
- [Publication Certificate](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/certificate): Certificate of publication service for published authors

- [About Us](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/about): Overview of International Journal of Applied Research mission and indexing
